scope: Mac-only sustained Codex lifecycle observation, file rotation and process restart recovery

interpretation.durability: passed for this 16 minute 54 second synthetic Mac-only run
interpretation.memory: Long-running Debug RSS peaked near 292 MiB, then a cold start over the same 600-run history settled near 142-150 MiB. This is not enough to prove a leak, but Release and Instruments profiling remain required before calling resource behavior production-ready.

limitations: This was a synthetic lifecycle stream, not sixteen minutes of real model work or a multi-hour real-user observation.
The app was allowed to run behind the active terminal, but macOS sleep and wake were intentionally not triggered on the remotely controlled Mac.
No provisioned App Sandbox, iPhone, Claude account, Release build or Instruments allocation trace was used.
The changes remain uncommitted and have not been pushed, merged, installed or released.
